data.theme: Gender Differences in Engineering Competencies and Self-Efficacy
data.definition: The examination of how gender influences engineering students' self-efficacy, competencies, and experiences, including the identification of gaps, gendered experiences, and the development of strategies to address disparities through curricular interventions.
subthemes: Curricular interventions to reduce gender disparities

data.theme: Psychometric Evaluation of Engineering Assessment Instruments
data.definition: The evaluation of the reliability, validity, and structural properties (e.g., factor analysis, confirmatory factor analysis) of tools used to measure engineering competencies, self-efficacy, and other affective or cognitive constructs in engineering education.

data.theme: Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competencies in Engineering
data.definition: The assessment and development of competencies related to innovation, entrepreneurship, and the ability to create or adapt to new technologies and business models in engineering students. This includes the measurement of innovation self-efficacy and entrepreneurial competencies.
